articles.title: Number of Hong Kong students in US down 27% over past 10 years
articles.summary:
The number of international students from Hong Kong in the United States has fallen by nearly 27 per cent over the past decade, with a slight year-on-year uptick of 0.5 per cent in the last school year despite the Trump administration’s clampdown on visas for students from mainland China and the city.
The latest data released by a US non-profit organisation on Monday showed that the rise was partly attributed to undergraduates, who recorded the strongest year-on-year growth at 4.1 per cent,...
